resolution: Retested on the fourth morning with the thickest slice: numbness at eleven counts, as on the first morning, and cleared from the tongue before he had ground a jin of liquorice. On the first day the same numbness had lasted five hours. The batch is jarred and in use.
summary: Nine aconite roots judged at eleven counts on the first morning and meant to dry one day more. They have now dried several days past that, untested, on the shelf under a cloth. He still cannot tell whether that morning's fault was in the batch or in him.
